annotations.rationale: Names one specific enzyme deficiency (hexosaminidase A deficiency) rather than a general term, so it is a Specific Disease.

Refers to a benign reduced-enzyme-activity state that is not clearly a disease; it is a derivative of the general term deficiency, so it is included only as a possible disease mention and marked excluded.
Named specific genetic disease (Tay-Sachs disease); the whole phrase is kept as the minimum necessary span.

annotations.rationale: Abbreviation for Tay-Sachs disease, annotated as a separate synonymous mention.
Abbreviation used as an adjective modifying the noun carriers (TSD carriers).
Abbreviation used as an adjective modifying heterozygotes (TSD heterozygotes).
Abbreviation used as an adjective modifying patient (French TSD patient).
Adjective describing the allele as a benign state rather than a disease; derived from the general term deficiency, so it is marked excluded.
